order_note: No predecessor and no order on this engine. SQL 135 needs public.check_intake_items with id, tenant_id, uploaded_by, status, check_stage, ocr_status, front_image_path, back_image_path, ocr_needs_verification, carrier_name, check_number, payee_line, property_address, funds_type, review_notes, payee_address, expiration_days, is_multi_payee, issue_date, amount, claim_id, cash_job_id, check_source and cash_job_payment_class (restored Supabase schema; the cash-job columns from supabase/migrations/20260522142101_*.sql), owned by checksops_admin, and the roles checksops and authenticated; the file itself raises sql135_table_missing, sql135_column_missing or sql135_role_missing otherwise. The check create (handleCreateCheck, POST /workflow/checks, aws/functions/api/workflow.mjs) inserts those columns as checksops: the first twenty on every create, claim_id on every create since #1317 (2026-10-27), and the three cash-job columns for a check uploaded from a cash job. SQL 50 granted column INSERT on the first twenty to checksops and authenticated, SQL 51 revokes INSERT on the table from both where it is run, and no migration grants INSERT on claim_id or the cash-job columns, so on staging PostgreSQL refuses the create before row-level security (/aws/lambda/checksops-staging-api 2026-10-31 13:06:40Z and 13:15:40Z: 403, permission denied for table check_intake_items). Production's checksops held table-level INSERT at the SQL 89 inspect (ACL checksops=arwd, ard after SQL 89), so the create is not refused there; SQL 135 makes both environments the same column state: checksops INSERT on the twenty-four columns, no authenticated INSERT on them, SQL 89's checksops UPDATE on seventeen of them unchanged. The policies aws_write_check_intake_items (aws/rls/sql/21_proposed_write_policies.sql: aws_can_write_tenant(tenant_id)) and aws_select_check_intake_items stay the authorization boundary and are not changed; the table ACL is not changed (production's table-level INSERT stays). If the read-only inspect finds every pinned line held and no authenticated INSERT it reports already_applied true and nothing is applied (the pin is then recorded as verified live, not applied). No later migration revokes these grants. Other API inserts into check_intake_items (aws/functions/api/homeowner.mjs: claim_id, tenant_id, uploaded_by, front_image_path, back_image_path, amount, status, check_stage, check_source) name a subset of these columns.
